name: tap_in_order_sweep
prompt: Tap the numbered blue circles in order: 1, then 2, then 3, and so on through the highest number. Wrong order fails the eval immediately. Take a fresh screenshot before each tap so you can confirm which circle is which.

name: find_odd_one_color
prompt: Among the grid of similar blue circles, exactly one has a slightly different color. Tap that circle. You have one chance — examine the image carefully before tapping.

name: count_then_tap_sweep
prompt: Count the red circles in the scattered field. Then tap the numbered tile at the bottom matching that count. You have one chance.
